vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 03-storyboard-prompter
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is a straightforward utility for generating AI image prompts from scene descriptions. The logic in skill.js performs basic string interpolation to create positive and negative prompts without any network requests, file system access, or suspicious execution patterns. All files, including SKILL.md and manifest.json, are consistent with the stated purpose of local prompt generation.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose: a small local transformer that converts scene objects into positive/negative AI art prompts, with no network calls, no credentials, and no install steps.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (storyboard prompt generation) matches the code and SKILL.md. The skill only needs a list of scene objects and produces shot_list prompts; nothing requested is unrelated to the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs local-only conversion of scene data into prompts. The code follows that: it formats positive and negative prompts from provided scene fields and does not read files, env vars, or contact external endpoints. Note: the code assumes scene objects have properties like scene, character, action; missing properties will appear as 'undefined' in output (a robustness bug, not a security issue).
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no downloads. The skill is an instruction + tiny JS file, so nothing is written or fetched at install time.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Its inputs are the scenes array declared in the manifest; requested access is minimal and proportional.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true, does not modify other skills, and does not request persistent agent privileges. Autonomous invocation is allowed by default but is not combined with any other privilege escalation signals.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This is a simple, local prompt-generation skill and appears safe to install. Before use: (1) validate the scenes you pass in actually contain scene/character/action fields to avoid 'undefined' tokens in prompts; (2) avoid including sensitive or private data in scene text because the skill embeds input verbatim into prompts (even though it runs locally); (3) if you want stricter sanitization or richer prompts, consider modifying the small skill.js to validate and normalize fields.
